scientific_question: Does a nontrivial, state-conditioned external-view value gap exist after marginalizing Pi0.5 flow noise, can observable inputs predict it, and does a frozen selector generalize to source-disjoint states?

estimands.statewise_oracle: v_star(s)=argmax_v J_theta(s,v) over the frozen 97-view operational bank
estimands.confirmed_search_lower_bound: J_theta(s,v_hat_P(s))-J_theta(s,canonical), where v_hat_P is selected by independent O then P banks and evaluated only on Q

included: fixed external camera during each closed-loop rollout
one frozen AlphaBrain Pi0.5 checkpoint as the primary dense map
source-disjoint generalization of a selector frozen before test outcomes are opened
excluded: the exact infinite-sample maximum over views
universal view optimality across checkpoint families or embodiments

legacy_evidence.interpretation: motivates a better powered dense design; it is not a preregistered confirmatory result

population.test_selection: two SHA256-ranked states per task drawn only from the prior heldout_test source pool
population.test_outcome_embargo: no test dense/refinement outcome analysis and no test-dependent selector change before a selector-freeze receipt exists

refinement.conditions: canonical plus top8 noncanonical views selected per state using O only

confirmation.development_conditions: canonical plus one statewise candidate selected using P only
confirmation.test_conditions: canonical, statewise candidate, dev-frozen global and task-fixed baselines, and every dev-frozen learned selector candidate with duplicate views evaluated once

selection.O_to_P: canonical plus top8 noncanonical by higher success, higher progress, lower harm, faster successful completion, lexicographic ID
selection.P_to_Q: top1 noncanonical by the same frozen order

learner_layer.training_population: development states only with source-grouped six-fold cross-validation
candidate_learner_inputs: candidate rendered image only for the explicitly image-queryable selector variant

statistics_and_gates.primary_interval: paired source-cluster bootstrap 95 percent with task stratification

oracle_existence.statistical: Q-test statewise candidate minus canonical CI excludes zero
oracle_existence.practical: Q-test source-equal point gain is at least 5 percentage points

state_dependence.statistical: Q-test statewise candidate minus dev-frozen global fixed view CI excludes zero
state_dependence.practical: point difference is at least 3 percentage points
state_dependence.required_reporting: candidate identity diversity and per-task/state regret distribution

learner_generalization.statistical: Q-test learned selector minus canonical CI excludes zero
learner_generalization.practical: gain is at least 3 percentage points, captures at least half of positive confirmed oracle headroom, and harm increase is no more than 5 percentage points

statistics_and_gates.reserve_activation: activate R only if a primary Q-test CI half-width exceeds 5 percentage points or first-half versus full-Q point estimate shifts by more than 5 percentage points
